$comment: Knowledge Engine — KB store descriptor (kb/store.json). Advisory-but-hashed identity for one store directory: three logical KBs over one physical JSONL layout (kb/platform/records.jsonl, kb/ui/records.jsonl, kb/project/<projectId>/records.jsonl, kb/relations/records.jsonl). The store files themselves are the truth; this descriptor is regenerated by det kb ingest/sync and its contentHash anchors the deterministic re-index proof. Derived indexes (SQLite FTS5 or otherwise) are rebuildable caches and never appear here.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB store descriptor

platforms.$comment: Platform families present in the KB-1 partition.

projects.$comment: KB-3 project partitions (directory names under kb/project/).

counts.$comment: Record totals per logical KB. The KB validator re-derives them from the JSONL partitions and flags drift.
